fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM57,665. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057144/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM with a Credit in three (3) subjects MSU College Business Management Certificate (MQF Level 3) with a Pass in all subjects Equivalent Certificate (MQF Level 3) from Polytechnics or Public Universities (IPTAs) recognized by MSU Senate Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least a Grade B in three (3) subjects Pass O-Level with at least a Grade C in three (3) subjects Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia (SKM) Level 3 in a related field and pass SPM with a Credit in at least one (1) subject Community College Certificate (MQF Level 3) in a relevant field and pass SPM with a Credit in at least one (1) subject STPM or equivalent with at least a Grade C (2.00 CGPA) in one (1) subject STAM with Maqbul Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Malaysian Government
